name: Shoujo no Jikuu Kaiki Nisshoku
source:
On the morning of August 31st, a shut-in boy named Yousuke meets a mysterious young girl named Merry.

She calls herself the "child of the sun and the moon"...

This is a story of a small wonder, and a trio of 2 boys and a girl.

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/21331760]official website[/url]]
